reply: [{"query": "根据FDA这份《风险为本临床试验监查》问答指南（2023年4月），发起人在监查中发现重大问题后，须在多少天或多少个工作日内向FDA报告？", "query_en": "According to this FDA Risk-Based Approach to Monitoring of Clinical Investigations Q&A guidance (April 2023), within how many days or business days must a sponsor report significant monitoring findings to FDA?", "topic": "重大监查问题报告FDA的时限", "absence_terms": ["days", "business days", "timeframe", "deadline"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 12, "text": "Significant issues identified through monitoring and oversight activities and the actions to be taken should be documented and communicated to the appropriate parties, which may include, but are not limited to (1) sponsor management; (2) sponsor teams; (3) clinical sites; (4) institutional review boards; (5) other relevant parties (for example, DMCs and relevant contract research organizations); and (6) applicable regulatory agencies, including FDA, when appropriate."}, "rationale": "该问题询问指南是否规定向FDA报告重大监查发现的具体时限，属于监查后续沟通范围内的自然问题，但文档仅要求以“timely manner”通报，未给出任何天数或截止时限。"}, {"query": "根据这份FDA风险为本监查问答指南，发起人聘用的临床监查员（clinical monitor）本身应具备哪些资质、培训或认证要求？", "query_en": "According to this FDA risk-based monitoring Q&A guidance, what qualifications, training, or certification requirements must a sponsor's clinical monitor personnel possess?", "topic": "监查员本身的资质认证要求", "absence_terms": ["certification", "qualified monitor", "credentials", "monitor qualifications"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 9, "text": "Adequate staffing to support the clinical investigation. Specific considerations include relevant study-specific trainings of site staff, the experience and qualifications of the research coordinator and specialized research professionals working with and under the direction of the clinical investigator, and turnover of personnel at the investigational site or among monitoring staff."}, "rationale": "文档在人员配置因素中仅讨论现场人员（研究协调员等）的经验资质及监查人员的流动情况，并未说明发起人一方监查员自身应具备何种资质、培训或认证，因此该问题在监查计划范围内但缺乏可回答条款。"}]
